summary: Task Scheduler (Kanban Boards) feature fully tested. Backend: 24/24 tests PASSED. Fixed route ordering bug in columns/reorder endpoint. Frontend: All UI components working - Board list view, Kanban board view with draggable columns/tasks, Task detail modal with all fields, inline task creation, board CRUD.
seed_data_creation: Test tasks and boards created during testing were cleaned up via API delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Task Boards feature is fully functional. All CRUD operations for boards, columns, tasks, comments, and attachments work correctly. The feature 'task_boards' is enabled on dbntstudio main site. Default columns (To Do, In Progress, Review, Done) are created automatically with each new board.

bug_fixed.issue: Column reorder endpoint (/api/task-boards/boards/{boardId}/columns/reorder) was returning null instead of {status: 'reordered'}
bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI route ordering conflict - the /columns/reorder endpoint was defined AFTER /columns/{column_id}, causing 'reorder' to be matched as a column_id parameter
bug_fixed.fix: Moved the ColumnsReorder model and reorder_columns endpoint BEFORE the column_id endpoints in /app/backend/routers/task_boards.py

board_crud.notes: Default 4 columns created automatically on board creation

task_crud.notes: Tasks support title, description, priority, deadline, assignee, labels, checklist

attachments.notes: Max file size 10MB, supports S3 or local storage
